name: shopsmart-workspace
description: ShopSmart - Intentionally vulnerable e-commerce platform for security testing

scripts.docker:up: docker-compose up -d && echo '⏳ Waiting for services to be healthy...' && sleep 5
scripts.db:seed: cd be && npm run prisma:push && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.dev:api: cd be && DATABASE_URL='postgresql://shop:shop@localhost:5432/shop' REDIS_URL='redis://localhost:6379' PORT=4000 FRONTEND_ORIGIN='http://localhost:3000' MASS_ASSIGNMENT_FLAG='PCTFS{mass_assignment_privilege_escalation}' SHOPSMART_FLAG='PCTFS{ssti_invoice_template_injection}' SSTI_EMAIL_FLAG='PCTFS{ssti_email_template_displayname}' VULN_COMPONENT_FLAG='PCTFS{eval_debug_console_rce}' PILLOW_FLAG='PCTFS{pillow_8_1_0_buffer_overflow_memory_leak}' SSRF_FLAG='PCTFS{ssrf_internal_service_reached}' ADMIN_EMAIL='admin@shopsmart.com' ADMIN_PASSWORD='SuperSecretAdminPass123' npm run dev
scripts.start: npm run docker:up && npm run db:seed && npm run dev
scripts.stop: npm run docker:down && pkill -f 'nodemon' && pkill -f 'next dev'
scripts.setup: cd be && npm install && cd ../fe && npm install && cd .. && npm install
scripts.clean: npm run docker:down && docker volume rm med-lab_postgres_data 2>/dev/null || true
